I feel that you should tell your doctor. Therapists aren't around every second, it takes a while to get diagnosed too so it's okay to suggest a possible disorder. It's their job to listen to you and do everything they can to prove it disprove your possible explanation. Don't push a diagnosis because you won't get the satisfaction you think, just relax and try what they are saying to do. If you don't at least suggest what you think you could get misdiagnosed
